newsitem.title: USA: CBOT full membership sells for record $825,001.
newsitem.headline: CBOT full membership sells for record $825,001.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade said a full seat on the exchange changed hands Thursday for a record price of $825,001.
The highest price previously paid for a full CBOT membership was $775,001 on April 8.
The current bid for a full CBOT seat is $825,000 and the current asking price is $900,000. A full membership allows trading of all CBOT contracts.

In addition, the exchange said its U.S. Treasury bond futures contract on Wednesday set an open interest record of 602,440 contracts, surpassing the previous record of 590,302 open positions set May 8.
